experiment.hypothesis: A three-step checklist gets new writers to their first document.

sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS actor
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793987008559
    AND e.ts_ms < 1795024560921
    AND e.event IN ('$exposure', 'document_created')
),
xr AS (
  SELECT ev.actor AS actor, ev.ts_ms AS ts_ms, (CASE json_type(ev.props, '$."variant"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(ev.props, '$."variant"') AS TEXT) END) AS variant FROM ev
  WHERE ev.event = '$exposure' AND (CASE json_type(ev.props, '$."flag"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(ev.props, '$."flag"') AS TEXT) END) = 'onboarding-checklist' AND ev.ts_ms < 1795024560921 AND 1 = 1
    AND (CASE json_type(ev.props, '$."variant"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(ev.props, '$."variant"') AS TEXT) END) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE json_type(ev.props, '$."variant"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(ev.props, '$."variant"') AS TEXT) END) <> ''
),
x AS (SELECT actor, MIN(ts_ms) AS t0, COUNT(DISTINCT variant) AS nv, MIN(variant) AS anyv FROM xr GROUP BY actor),
xe AS (SELECT actor, t0, anyv AS variant FROM x WHERE nv = 1)
SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS exposures, MIN(t0) AS first_exposure, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM x WHERE nv > 1) AS multi FROM xe GROUP BY variant
